mentions.name: First Steam game launch
mentions.description: A video game being prepared for launch on Steam; it is the author's first commercial game release, following earlier paper-based games and a first video game made on the C64.
mentions.source_excerpt: After a long diversion working in auto industry (I’m still working)  I’m preparing to launch my first game here: http://store.steampowered.com/app/4265740/
mentions.author: notyourav
